{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast to float
completed_orders['revenue_float'] = completed_orders['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and exclude QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
real_completed = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_float'] != 999999.99]

# Verify the count of completed orders and real completed orders
n_completed = len(completed_orders)
n_real_completed = len(real_completed)

# Compute mean revenue of real completed orders
mean_revenue_real = real_completed['revenue_float'].mean()

# Print key numbers for evidence
print(f"Number of completed orders: {n_completed}")
print(f"Number of real completed orders (excluding QA): {n_real_completed}")
print(f"Mean revenue of real completed orders: {mean_revenue_real}")

# Return the mean for the report
mean_revenue_real"}
